description: Get current follower count, 7-day and 30-day growth, and a daily follower-count history. Supported on these platforms only: instagram, twitter, bluesky, threads, facebook, linkedin, pinterest, tiktok, youtube, mastodon (not telegram or google-business). Note: tiktok reports no follower counts (platform limitation). Pass accountId (from list_accounts) for one account, or OMIT it to get per-account blocks for ALL analytics-enabled accounts plus summed totals in one call (totals exclude YouTube per its API policy). Optional window in days (1-365, default 30). Returns nulls/empty history when no snapshots exist yet.

accountId.description: Account id from list_accounts. Omit to merge across all analytics accounts.

platform.description: Optional. Scopes the merged mode to one platform; auto-resolved from accountId otherwise.

name: get_follower_growth
title: Get Follower Growth
